last_council:ash.title: House Ash
last_council:ash.description: House Ash controls old stone roads, bridges, toll posts and timber yards in the northern hills.
last_council:ash.interests: Safe trade routes, bridge repairs and recognition for northern towns.

last_council:rowan.title: House Rowan
last_council:rowan.description: House Rowan moves goods through river barges and market warehouses, connecting the ports.
last_council:rowan.interests: Open river markets, favorable duties and dependable trading partners.

last_council:vale.title: House Vale
last_council:vale.description: House Vale?s valley farms and granaries make it a leading wheat exporter.
last_council:vale.interests: Agricultural influence, dependable roads and allies for valley towns.

last_council:reed.title: House Reed
last_council:reed.description: House Reed holds the ferries and granaries along the lower river. Its boatmen move grain and passengers between inland estates and the coast.
last_council:reed.interests: Open waterways, affordable river tolls and protection for the ferry towns.

last_council:elm.title: House Elm
last_council:elm.description: House Elm governs sheltered orchards and market towns in the southern valleys. Its cider presses and seasonal fairs bring merchants from across the realm.
last_council:elm.interests: Reliable harvest trade, peaceful markets and a strong voice for the southern towns.

last_council:flint.title: House Flint
last_council:flint.description: House Flint owns the western quarries and iron workings. Its masons and smiths supply building stone, tools and fittings for the realm's roads and fortifications.
last_council:flint.interests: Mining charters, payment for public works and dependable overland trade.

last_council:mere.title: House Mere
last_council:mere.description: House Mere commands the lake ports and their fishing fleets. Its pilots know the narrow channels linking remote settlements with the main trading routes.
last_council:mere.interests: Safe harbours, fishing rights and a Council that listens to the lake settlements.

last_council:thorn.title: House Thorn
last_council:thorn.description: House Thorn holds scattered keeps and grazing lands along the border. Its riders escort merchants through exposed passes and maintain the remote watch posts.
last_council:thorn.interests: Funding for border defence, secure trade passes and recognition for the marches.
